company.name: MTLAB
company.shortDescription: MTLab provides AI tools that help businesses create, manage, and optimize e-commerce operations using artificial intelligence.
company.description: MTLAB AI is a Dubai-based artificial intelligence and deep-tech company focused on transforming the future of digital shopping and social commerce. The company develops AI-powered retail solutions that combine virtual try-on technology, personal styling, conversational AI, augmented reality, and automated checkout experiences. Its flagship platform, DAVE, acts as an intelligent AI shopping assistant that helps users discover, style, and purchase fashion products seamlessly across online stores. MTLAB aims to remove friction from e-commerce by integrating advanced AI, personalization, and immersive shopping experiences into one unified ecosystem for brands, retailers, and consumers.
